description: A Node.js-based proxy script that intercepts and possibly modifies specific method calls related to session management, forwarding commands to a spawned target process while injecting MCP server information into certain messages.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes and validates the payload argument to extract targetCommand and mcpServers.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines if a given method requires injection of MCP servers.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Parses a line of input, injects MCP servers into specific method calls, and returns the possibly modified line.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks if the current script is the main module being executed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up the process proxy and handles I/O and process lifecycle.
